meta.themes: Safety Controls, Agent Workflows, Enterprise Rollouts, Compute Expansion

news.title: OpenAI rolled out GPT-5.5 Instant as ChatGPT's new default model
news.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.5 Instant with tighter responses, lower hallucination rates in internal testing, and stronger day-to-day utility for the default ChatGPT experience.

news.title: OpenAI introduced Trusted Contact safety escalation in ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI began rolling out an opt-in Trusted Contact feature that can alert a nominated person in severe self-harm risk scenarios after automated and human review.

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-Realtime-2, Translate, and Whisper streaming models
news.summary: OpenAI added new realtime voice API models for spoken reasoning, live translation, and low-latency transcription, expanding production voice-agent building options.

news.title: OpenAI published MRC networking to improve large-cluster training resilience
news.summary: OpenAI and partners released the MRC protocol via OCP to boost reliability and throughput across multi-plane AI supercomputer networks at frontier training scale.

news.title: Anthropic formed a new enterprise AI services company with major investors
news.summary: Anthropic announced a new services venture with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs to deliver Claude deployments for mid-sized enterprises.

news.title: Anthropic released finance-focused agent templates for Claude Cowork and Code
news.summary: Anthropic shipped ten financial-services agent templates, plus Microsoft 365 integrations and connector expansion, to speed production adoption of Claude agents.

news.title: Anthropic announced a new compute agreement with SpaceX
news.summary: Anthropic said its SpaceX agreement adds over 300 megawatts of near-term capacity and supported higher Claude Code and API usage limits for paid customers.

news.title: Microsoft outlined Frontier Firm operating patterns and Copilot Cowork expansion
news.summary: Microsoft's 2026 Work Trend Index framing emphasized AI operating-model redesign and announced broader Copilot Cowork mobile and plugin ecosystem support.

news.title: US Commerce expanded pre-release AI model testing with Google, Microsoft, and xAI
news.summary: BBC reported new voluntary agreements for CAISI safety evaluations of frontier models before release, extending earlier arrangements that included OpenAI and Anthropic.

news.title: AWS and OpenAI expanded Bedrock access for frontier models, Codex, and managed agents
news.summary: At What's Next with AWS, Amazon announced limited-preview Bedrock support for OpenAI models, Codex on Bedrock, and OpenAI-powered managed agents.

news.title: Alphabet highlighted Cloud AI acceleration in Q1 with revenue above $20 billion
news.summary: Alphabet said AI demand pushed Google Cloud revenue up 63% past $20 billion, with larger backlog and expanded Gemini, TPU, and enterprise agent platform momentum.

news.title: OpenAI detailed enterprise controls and telemetry for safer Codex deployment
news.summary: OpenAI published operational guidance on Codex sandboxing, approval policies, network restrictions, and audit logging to govern coding agents in production teams.
